en.title: Can PurpleHere connect to my card terminal?
en.content:
Yes — with a GHL card terminal running PayHere Direct.

How it works:
• The PurpleHere POS app (Android tablet or Windows PC) finds the terminal on your Wi-Fi by itself — nothing to type in
• At checkout the amount goes to the terminal automatically; the customer taps a card or scans a QR
• The payment is recorded only when the terminal approves, and PurpleHere notes whether it was a card or an e-wallet (Touch 'n Go, GrabPay, DuitNow QR and more)
• Nothing for staff to retype, no manual card records

Which terminal:
• GHL terminals differ by model and software version, so please apply for your terminal through PurpleHere (purplehere.com/contact?type=card_terminal). We confirm a compatible unit and get it set up for your outlet
• A terminal arranged elsewhere may not connect

If you don't have a terminal yet, you can still take card payments and record them by hand in the POS.

ko.title: PurpleHere 에 카드단말기를 연결할 수 있나요?
ko.content:
네 — PayHere Direct 가 깔린 GHL 카드단말기와 연결돼요.

어떻게 되나요:
• PurpleHere 계산대 앱(안드로이드 태블릿·Windows PC)이 와이파이에서 단말기를 저절로 찾아요 — 입력할 게 없어요
• 결제 때 금액이 단말기로 자동으로 넘어가고, 손님은 카드를 대거나 QR 을 찍어요
• 단말기가 승인할 때만 결제가 기록되고, 카드인지 이월렛(Touch 'n Go·GrabPay·DuitNow QR 등)인지도 함께 남아요
• 직원이 다시 입력할 것도, 수기 카드 기록도 없어요

어떤 단말기인가요:
• GHL 단말기는 기종·소프트웨어 버전이 달라 변수가 많아요. 단말기는 PurpleHere 를 통해 신청해 주세요(purplehere.com/contact?type=card_terminal). 호환되는 기종을 확인하고 매장에 맞게 준비해 드려요
• 다른 경로로 받은 단말기는 연결을 보장하지 못해요

아직 단말기가 없어도 카드 결제를 받고 POS 에 직접 기록할 수는 있어요.

zh.title: PurpleHere 可以连接我的刷卡机吗？
zh.content:
可以 — 支持安装了 PayHere Direct 的 GHL 刷卡机。

运作方式：
• PurpleHere 收银应用（Android 平板或 Windows 电脑）会在您的 Wi-Fi 中自动找到刷卡机 — 无需输入任何内容
• 结账时金额自动发送到刷卡机，顾客拍卡或扫描 QR 即可
• 只有刷卡机批准后才会记录付款，PurpleHere 还会记下是银行卡还是电子钱包（Touch 'n Go、GrabPay、DuitNow QR 等）
• 员工无需重新输入，也没有手工刷卡记录

哪种刷卡机：
• GHL 刷卡机因型号和软件版本不同而存在很多变数，请通过 PurpleHere 申请刷卡机（purplehere.com/contact?type=card_terminal）。我们会确认兼容的型号，并为您的门店准备好
• 通过其他渠道取得的刷卡机不保证能够连接

如果您还没有刷卡机，仍然可以收取银行卡付款并在 POS 中手动记录。

ms.title: Bolehkah PurpleHere disambungkan ke terminal kad saya?
ms.content:
Ya — dengan terminal kad GHL yang menjalankan PayHere Direct.

Cara ia berfungsi:
• Aplikasi PurpleHere POS (tablet Android atau PC Windows) mencari terminal di Wi-Fi anda dengan sendirinya — tiada apa-apa untuk ditaip
• Semasa pembayaran, jumlah dihantar ke terminal secara automatik; pelanggan hanya ketik kad atau imbas QR
• Pembayaran direkodkan hanya apabila terminal meluluskannya, dan PurpleHere mencatat sama ada ia kad atau e-dompet (Touch 'n Go, GrabPay, DuitNow QR dan lain-lain)
• Kakitangan tidak perlu menaip semula, tiada rekod kad manual

Terminal yang mana:
• Terminal GHL berbeza mengikut model dan versi perisian, jadi sila mohon terminal anda melalui PurpleHere (purplehere.com/contact?type=card_terminal). Kami sahkan unit yang serasi dan sediakannya untuk outlet anda
• Terminal yang diperoleh melalui saluran lain mungkin tidak dapat disambungkan

Jika anda belum mempunyai terminal, anda masih boleh menerima bayaran kad dan merekodkannya secara manual dalam POS.

en.title: What do I need at the counter for everything to run automatically?
en.content:
Three things: a tablet (or PC), a receipt/kitchen printer and a GHL card terminal.

With those three:
• Orders from the POS, table QR codes and the self-order kiosk print in the kitchen by themselves
• The bill amount goes to the card terminal by itself; the payment is recorded when the terminal approves — card, e-wallet QR or DuitNow QR
• Staff never retype an amount or an order

Set-up:
• Install the free PurpleHere POS app on the counter tablet or PC (purplehere.com/download) — it connects the printer and the terminal
• Printer: Settings › Printer walks you through connecting it
• Card terminal: apply through PurpleHere (purplehere.com/contact?type=card_terminal) so we can confirm a compatible GHL model, then turn it on under Settings › Payment › Card

You can use your own tablet and printer, or choose a ready-made package at purplehere.com/packages.

ko.title: 계산대에 뭐가 있어야 전부 자동으로 돌아가나요?
ko.content:
세 가지예요: 태블릿(또는 PC), 영수증·주방 프린터, GHL 카드단말기.

이 셋이 있으면:
• POS·테이블 QR·셀프 주문 키오스크 주문이 주방 프린터에서 저절로 나와요
• 결제 금액이 카드단말기로 저절로 넘어가고, 단말기가 승인하면 기록돼요 — 카드·이월렛 QR·DuitNow QR 모두
• 직원이 금액이나 주문을 다시 입력하는 일이 없어요

준비:
• 계산대 태블릿·PC 에 무료 PurpleHere 계산대 앱을 설치해요(purplehere.com/download) — 프린터와 단말기를 연결해 줘요
• 프린터: 설정 › 프린터에서 순서대로 안내해요
• 카드단말기: PurpleHere 를 통해 신청해 주세요(purplehere.com/contact?type=card_terminal). 호환되는 GHL 기종을 확인해 드리고, 받으면 설정 › 결제 › 카드에서 켜면 돼요

갖고 있는 태블릿·프린터를 그대로 써도 되고, purplehere.com/packages 에서 준비된 패키지를 골라도 돼요.

zh.title: 收银台需要什么设备才能让一切自动运行？
zh.content:
三样东西：一台平板（或电脑）、一台收据/厨房打印机和一台 GHL 刷卡机。

有了这三样：
• POS、桌台 QR 码和自助点餐机的订单会自动在厨房打印
• 账单金额自动发送到刷卡机；刷卡机批准后即记录付款 — 银行卡、电子钱包 QR 或 DuitNow QR 都一样
• 员工无需再次输入金额或订单

设置：
• 在收银平板或电脑上安装免费的 PurpleHere 收银应用（purplehere.com/download）— 它负责连接打印机和刷卡机
• 打印机：设置 › 打印机 会一步步引导您连接
• 刷卡机：请通过 PurpleHere 申请（purplehere.com/contact?type=card_terminal），我们会确认兼容的 GHL 型号，收到后在 设置 › 付款 › 银行卡 中开启即可

您可以使用自己的平板和打印机，也可以在 purplehere.com/packages 选择现成的套餐。

ms.title: Apa yang saya perlukan di kaunter supaya semuanya berjalan secara automatik?
ms.content:
Tiga perkara: tablet (atau PC), pencetak resit/dapur dan terminal kad GHL.

Dengan tiga perkara ini:
• Pesanan dari POS, kod QR meja dan kiosk pesanan sendiri dicetak di dapur dengan sendirinya
• Jumlah bil dihantar ke terminal kad dengan sendirinya; pembayaran direkodkan apabila terminal meluluskannya — kad, QR e-dompet atau DuitNow QR
• Kakitangan tidak perlu menaip semula jumlah atau pesanan

Persediaan:
• Pasang aplikasi PurpleHere POS percuma pada tablet atau PC kaunter (purplehere.com/download) — ia menyambungkan pencetak dan terminal
• Pencetak: Tetapan › Pencetak membimbing anda langkah demi langkah
• Terminal kad: mohon melalui PurpleHere (purplehere.com/contact?type=card_terminal) supaya kami boleh sahkan model GHL yang serasi, kemudian hidupkannya di Tetapan › Pembayaran › Kad

Anda boleh menggunakan tablet dan pencetak sendiri, atau pilih pakej sedia ada di purplehere.com/packages.
